content: We develop a variety of ShapeWorldICE datasets, with a similar idea to the “skill tasks” in the bAbI framework BIBREF22. Table TABREF4 gives an overview for different ShapeWorldICE datasets we use in this paper. We consider three different types of captioning tasks, each of which focuses on a distinct aspect of reasoning abilities. Existential descriptions examine whether a certain object is present in an image. Spatial descriptions identify spatial relationships among visual objects. Quantification descriptions involve count-based and ratio-based statements, with an explicit focus on inspecting models for their counting ability. We develop two variants for each type of dataset to enable different levels of visual complexity or specific aspects of the same reasoning type. All the training and test captions sampled in this work are in English.
